scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
Agent researched a disjoint batch; integration and structural checks are not independent historical certification.
Imported border coordinates remain unchanged. Historical events and map coverage are distinguished in prose; see batchIdentityNotes for conflicts.

batchIdentityNotes: The exact id siam is retained, but its only decoded feature consists of three tiny slivers in the 1800 file.
The simultaneous rattanakosin-kingdom feature owns Bangkok and major centers normally associated with the wider realm.
All three exact centroid probes are cambodia in 1783 and 1815, making the target an editorial geometry anomaly rather than a fifteen-year state.
Bangkok court power, tributary relationships, regional mueang and local communities are described as different scales, not one fixed national border.
Thai, Lao, Khmer, Mon, Malay, Chinese, Cham, Muslim and other identities and languages are not collapsed into a single people.
The Thai sample is the secure title of the 1805 Three Seals court compilation and is explicitly not assigned to sliver residents.
The 1815 endpoint is a map-layer removal, not a fall; fell remains null and no automatic predecessor or successor is invented.
